title: Pāṭala L0 — token-level literal substrate record
description: One L0 record per token/fragment of an immutable T1 chunk. This is the agnostic, machine-readable contract every L0 layer (IPVV, IPK, Tantrāloka, Kubjikā, any future work) must satisfy. Coordinates are dual: chunk-absolute + line-relative. Never edit an emitted record in place — a fix emits a new version.

chunk_id.description: the immutable T1 chunk this token came from

line_id.description: 1-based physical line number in the chunk

line_kind.description: classification of the containing line (agnostic: reuse, do not re-segment)

chunk_char_start.description: absolute offset into the FULL joined T1 chunk text

line_char_start.description: offset relative to the containing source_line; null when wraps_line

line_char_end.description: exclusive, relative to the containing source_line; null when wraps_line

wraps_line.description: true when this token spans more than one physical line (so no single-line relative coords exist)

raw_fragment.description: the exact literal slice; MUST equal chunk_text[chunk_char_start:chunk_char_end]

source_text.description: the containing source line (for line-relative proof); the immutable T1 line

lemma_iast.description: IAST lemma (may be empty only when status = FAILED or AMBIGUOUS-no-lemma)

literal_gloss.description: literal meaning (may be empty only when status = FAILED)

quoted.description: token is inside a verbatim quotation span

status.description: PARSED = gloss+IAST recovered; AMBIGUOUS = recoverable but not clean; FAILED = present but not parseable
